name: ModelVariant785_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant785_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two groups of projectiles leave a model point with a random spread and arc under gravity, each wrapped in a ring of sprites and trailing swirling strips and a fading ribbon, while smoke puffs drift from the origin; landed projectiles bloom into growing layered fans with sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the projectile steps, rings, sparks and puffs and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once as each of the first three first-group projectiles lands, 1 once when all three have landed, 2 after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-802 and 899 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
